lines.japanese: 「よ、杉浦！」
lines.english: “Hey, Sugiura!”

lines.japanese: 「…おはよう、小木曽」
lines.english: “…Morning, Ogiso.”

lines.japanese:
「週末どうだった？　あ、バイトだっけ？
俺はまぁ、ケーキ食って肉食って酒止められて
仕方ないからシラフで騒いだくらいだったけど…」
lines.english: “How was your weekend? Oh, right—you were working, weren’t you? Me, I ate cake, stuffed myself with meat, got told I couldn’t drink, so I had to settle for raising hell sober…”

lines.japanese:
「入試を一週間後に控えて
それだけできれば大したものだと思う。
本当に度胸据わってるね、小木曽は」
lines.english: “With entrance exams a week away, that’s still pretty impressive. You really do have nerves of steel, Ogiso.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「今日は、先週よりちょっとだけ元気そうかなって」
lines.english: “You look a little better than you did last week.”

lines.japanese:
「…バイト、忙しかったからね。
息つく暇もないくらい」
lines.english: “…Work was busy. I barely had time to breathe.”

lines.japanese:
「忙しいと元気になるのかよ。
本当に貧乏性だな、杉浦は」
lines.english: “Being busy makes you feel better? You really don’t know how to relax, do you, Sugiura?”
“…You could say that.”

lines.japanese:
「でもよかった。もうすぐ卒業だもんな。
残り二週間、その調子で楽しく…」
lines.english: “Still, I’m glad. We graduate soon. Just enjoy these last two weeks and—”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ごめん、そろそろ行かないと」
lines.english: “Oh, sorry. I have to go.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、今から体育だっけ？」
lines.english: “You’ve got gym now, right?”

lines.japanese: 「そう…更衣室」
lines.english: “Yes… the changing room.”

lines.japanese: 「悪かったな、着替えの時間ギリギリになっちまった」
lines.english: “Sorry. I kept you talking and left you barely any time to change.”

lines.japanese: 「………着替え、か」
lines.english: “………Changing…”
“Sugiura?”

lines.japanese: 「ふふ…楽しくなりそうだなぁ」
lines.english: “Heh… Maybe this will be fun.”

lines.japanese: 「どうしたんだよ突然？」
lines.english: “What’s gotten into you?”

lines.japanese:
「知ってる小木曽？
わたし、スポーツ大好きなんだ」
lines.english: “Did you know, Ogiso? I love sports.”

lines.japanese:
「そりゃ…知ってるけどさ。
大会も見に行ったし」
lines.english: “Of course I know. I even went to see you compete.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃ、ね…ふふ」
lines.english: “See you later… heh.”

lines.japanese:
「みんながそう思ってるなら…なってあげるよ。
みんなが望むビッチに、ね」
lines.english: “If that’s what everyone thinks I am… then I’ll become it for them. The slut they all want.”

lines.japanese: 『ごちそうさま』
lines.english: “Thanks for the meal.”

lines.japanese:
『料理、受け取った。
届けてくれてありがとう。
それと、連絡取れずに本当にごめん』
lines.english: “I got the food. Thanks for bringing it over. And I’m really sorry I didn’t get in touch.”

lines.japanese:
『土曜からバイト先がパニクってて、
深夜まで働きづめで、部屋に帰っても寝るだけ。
メールがチェックできてなかった』
lines.english: “Work’s been a disaster since Saturday. I’ve been there until late every night, and by the time I got home all I could do was sleep. I never even checked my email.”

lines.japanese:
『そういうわけで、荷物を受け取った後で、
やっと雪菜のメールに気づいたくらいだった。
心配と、嫌な思いさせてしまってごめん』
lines.english: “I didn’t even see your message until after I got the package. I’m sorry I made you worry and put you through that.”

lines.japanese:
何度もついてるくせに、
いつまで経っても嘘が上手くならないな、俺…
lines.english: After all the lies I’d told, you would think I’d be better at it by now…

lines.japanese:
これが出版社の方なら説得力もあるけど、
深夜営業もないファミレスでそんな不測の事態が
起こるのかと聞かれれば、返す言葉もない。
lines.english: This might have sounded believable at the publisher. But what kind of emergency could there possibly be at a family restaurant without late-night hours? I wouldn’t have had an answer.

lines.japanese: …そんな事情も知らない雪菜だからこそつける嘘。
lines.english: A lie I could tell precisely because Setsuna knew none of that.

lines.japanese:
こんなふうに人を見て言葉を作ってしまうのは、
昔の俺が、ずっと嫌悪してやまない態度だった…
lines.english: Sizing someone up and tailoring my words to them—the old me had never stopped despising people who did that…

lines.japanese:
『料理、今さっき食べた。
雪菜の言う通り、焼き加減も味付けも最高だった。
冷めてても本当に美味しかった』
lines.english: “I just finished the food. You were right—it was cooked and seasoned perfectly. It was delicious even cold.”

lines.japanese:
『ケーキもありがとう。
それと、毎年ありがとう』
lines.english: “Thanks for the cake too. And for doing this every year.”

lines.japanese:
『最後に、当日になったからもう一度。
誕生日、おめでとう』
lines.english: “And now that it’s actually your birthday, let me say it one more time: happy birthday.”

lines.japanese:
だから最後だけは真実の言葉で、
少しでも良心の呵責を抑え込む。
lines.english: So I saved the truth for last, hoping it would quiet my conscience.

lines.japanese:
このメールを見て、
きっと雪菜は納得してしまうだろう。
疑問があっても、無理やり抑え込んでしまうだろう。
lines.english: Setsuna would read this and accept it. Whatever doubts she had, she would force them back down.

lines.japanese:
結局、そのことだけは、
どれだけ取り繕っても、
俺の頭から消えることはないんだけどな。
lines.english: That was the one thing I could not get out of my head, no matter how carefully I papered over it.

lines.japanese: それにしても…
lines.english: Still…

lines.japanese: やっぱり受信簿に、一昨日の雪菜からのメールはない。
lines.english: Setsuna’s message from two days ago was definitely not in my inbox.

lines.japanese: メール不達か、メールが消えたか…
lines.english: Either it had never arrived, or it had been deleted…

lines.japanese:
もし、不達でないとしたら、
どこで消えたのか…
lines.english: And if it had arrived, at what point had it disappeared…?

lines.japanese: そんな可能性、一つしかない。
lines.english: There was only one possibility I could think of.

lines.japanese:
土曜の夜は、俺の方が先に眠ってしまってた。
…そして小春は起きていた。
lines.english: I had fallen asleep first on Saturday night. Koharu had still been awake.

lines.japanese:
携帯は、部屋に転がってた。
ロックなんかかけてないから、誰でも操作できた。
lines.english: My phone had been lying there in the room. I never locked it. Anyone could have used it.

lines.japanese: 「小春…」
lines.english: “Koharu…”

lines.japanese:
もし俺の推測が当たってるとしたら…
お前は、どこへ行こうとしてるんだ？
lines.english: If I was right… where are you trying to go, Koharu?

lines.japanese:
お前がこうなってしまったのは俺のせいだけど、
俺が悪いって結論に、誰の反論も
受け入れるつもりはないけど。
lines.english: I was the one who had done this to you. I would not let anyone tell me it was not my fault.

lines.japanese:
でも、嘘の比率が上がりすぎだろ。
俺にも、本心を語らなさすぎだろ。
lines.english: But too much of your life had become a lie. And you would not tell even me how you really felt.

lines.japanese:
お前の真実は、
お前の誠実は…
lines.english: Your truth… your honesty…

lines.japanese: 一体、どこに行ってしまったんだよ？
lines.english: Where the hell had they gone?

lines.japanese:
「あれ？　来てたんだ孝宏。
なんで体育サボったん？」
lines.english: “Oh, you actually came, Takahiro. Why’d you skip PE?”

lines.japanese:
「そんなことやってる時間ないからだよ。
本番まであと５日だぜ？」
lines.english: “Because I don’t have time for that. The exam’s five days away.”

lines.japanese:
「だったらわざわざ学校なんかに来なくても…
どうせもう自主登校なんだから」
lines.english: “Then why bother coming to school? Attendance is optional now anyway.”

lines.japanese:
「一応、委員長だしな。
それにちょっと気になることがあったし」
lines.english: “I’m technically still the class rep. And there was something I wanted to check on.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと気になること、ねぇ…」
lines.english: “Something you wanted to check, huh…”

lines.japanese:
「それよりも悪いけど馬鹿話なら遠慮してくれ。
週末もパーティとかであんま進んでなくて、
正直ヤバいと思うようになってきた」
lines.english: “Anyway, if it’s just dumb chatter, spare me. I barely got any studying done over the weekend with the party, and I’m honestly starting to panic.”

lines.japanese:
「お前ほどの脳天気がそう思うってことは、
実質的には絶望レベルか…」
lines.english: “If even you think you’re in trouble, you must be completely screwed.”

lines.japanese: 「うっせ」
lines.english: “Shut up.”

lines.japanese:
「じゃあ、馬鹿話というには楽しくはないけど、
洒落にならないという意味ではとびっきりの新ネタを」
lines.english: “All right. It’s not exactly funny, but if you want something that’s seriously messed up, I’ve got a hell of a story.”

lines.japanese: 「人がヤバいって言ってんのに釣るなよ…」
lines.english: “Don’t dangle bait when I just told you I’m trying to study…”

lines.japanese:
「さっきの体育の時間…
女子どもが、また大炎上してたぞ」
lines.english: “Things blew up among the girls all over again during PE.”

lines.japanese: 「…何だそりゃ？」
lines.english: “…What the hell happened?”

lines.japanese: 「多分、もうすぐわかる」
lines.english: “You’ll find out soon enough.”

lines.japanese:
「なにあいつ！？
これ見よがしに！」
lines.english: “What the hell is wrong with her? She did that just to flaunt it!”

lines.japanese:
「何がしたいんだろうね、あれ？
さっぱりわからない」
lines.english: “What was she even trying to do? I honestly don’t get it.”

lines.japanese: 「あてつけ？」
lines.english: “Was that supposed to be a dig at someone?”

lines.japanese: 「って、誰に対してよ？」
lines.english: “At who?”

lines.japanese:
「自分で『私は淫乱です』って、
背中に貼ってるみたいなもんじゃんねぇ」
lines.english: “She might as well have taped a sign to her back saying, ‘I’m a slut.’”

lines.japanese:
「あ～んな恥も外聞もない奴とは思わなかった。
どんな顔してクラス委員なんかやってたんだか」
lines.english: “I never knew she was that shameless. How did she have the nerve to be our class rep all this time?”

lines.japanese: 「もうやりたい放題だね…」
lines.english: “She does whatever she wants now…”

lines.japanese: 「あれで答辞読むの？　本当に？」
lines.english: “And she’s going to give the graduation address? Seriously?”

lines.japanese:
「もう三年の恥。それどころか付属の恥。大恥！
消えて欲しいわマジで！」
lines.english: “She’s a disgrace to the whole senior class. Hell, to Houjou High. A complete disgrace! I seriously wish she’d just disappear!”

lines.japanese: 「………どういうこと、だよ？」
lines.english: “………What are they talking about?”

lines.japanese:
「それがさ…
更衣室で服脱いだら、
全身キスマークだらけだったんだと」
lines.english: “Apparently she took off her clothes in the changing room and had hickeys all over her body.”
“………What?”

lines.japanese:
「背中とか、肩とか、首とかさ。
しかも歯形まで」
lines.english: “Her back, shoulders, neck. There were even teeth marks.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、ちょっと待て…」
lines.english: “Wait a minute…”

lines.japanese:
「しかもそれを隠しもせずに、
堂々と背中見せつけるようにして着替えてたってさ。
…更衣室にいた女子全員凍りついてたってよ」
lines.english: “And instead of hiding them, she changed with her back on full display. Every girl in there just froze, apparently.”

lines.japanese: 「………杉浦のこと、だよな？」
lines.english: “………They mean Sugiura, don’t they?”

lines.japanese:
「例の噂にキレちまったのか、
元からそういう性格だったのか…
ま、火に油を注いでることは間違いないけどな」
lines.english: “Maybe the rumors made her snap. Maybe she was always like this. Either way, she’s definitely adding fuel to the fire.”

lines.japanese:
「で、杉浦は？
あいつは今、どこにいるんだよ？」
lines.english: “Where’s Sugiura? Where is she now?”

lines.japanese: 「帰ったよ、さっき…」
lines.english: “She went home a little while ago.”

lines.japanese: 「…まだ一時間目が終わったところだぞ？」
lines.english: “…First period only just ended.”

lines.japanese:
「自主登校だからな。
別に誰も咎める奴はいないよ」
lines.english: “Attendance is optional. No one’s going to stop her.”

lines.japanese: 「それは…」
lines.english: “But…”

lines.japanese:
「でも、だったらどうして
体育の時間だけ来たんだろうな？
…なんて、見せつけるため以外の何物でもないか」
lines.english: “Then why’d she show up just for PE? …I guess there really is no explanation except that she wanted everyone to see.”

lines.japanese:
「けど、どうやら男取ったってのは本当らしいな。
火のないところに煙はって言うけど、
ま～それにしても」
lines.english: “Looks like the rumor about her stealing someone’s boyfriend was true. They say where there’s smoke, there’s fire, but still…”

lines.japanese: 「どこへ行こうとしてんだよ…杉浦」
lines.english: “Where are you trying to go, Sugiura…?”
